mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation pressures ease.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month CPI change exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve initiates rate hikes to combat inflation, causing equity valuations to contract and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates accelerating labor market strength and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), wage pressures trigger Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, increasing recession risks and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to labor market strength, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), robust economic expansion supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%.
